newsitem.title: BRAZIL: RESEARCH ALERT-Sabesp started as a buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Sabesp started as a buy.

text.p: ING Barings said it has initiated coverage of Sao Paulo water and sewer utility Sabesp, known formally as Cia de Saneamento Basico do Estado de Sao Paulo, with a buy rating.

-- ING analyst Paulo Vasconcellos said in a report Sabesp, ranked 12th among Brazil's top government-owned firms in terms of revenues, is first among the country's basic sanitation firms and twice the size of the second-largest.

-- "We think a growing number of municipalities serviced, coupled with higher sewage penetration and lower water losses should expand Sabesp revenues at a compounded annual growth rate of 11.4 percent in dollar terms during the next five years," he wrote.
-- Vasconcellos estimated earnings for Sabesp at 550 million reais in 1997 and 854 million reais in 1998, excluding non-recurring expenses.
-- "The stock trades at a signficant discount to its peers," he said.
-- He added that, over the next 12 months, "uncertainties related to the new regulatory environment and to the estalishment of a new partnership will be significantly reduced."
-- ING has set a June 1998 price target for Sabesp of $445, for an upside potential of 51 percent.
-- Sabesp common was up 0.96 percent at 315 reais at 1521 local time/1421 EDT on the Sao Paulo bourse.
